a_extraction: Exact C path from the wordmark; translation and uniform scale only

variants.label: Open proportions
variants.summary: A broader C, open counters and measured spacing.
changes: C redrawn with a broad bowl, controlled overshoot and inclined terminals.
o redrawn to echo the C’s counter proportions. v has a shallow curved inner join.
C–o, o–v, v–a and a–n spaced individually; Labs uses 91% cap height.

variants.label: Closer proportions
variants.summary: A slightly narrower C and a closer word rhythm.
changes: C redrawn with a narrower bowl and more upright terminal cuts.
o and v narrowed with it; a/n adjusted in width to retain an even rhythm.
Pair spacing tightened selectively; the same restrained Labs proportions.

variants.label: Circular balance
variants.summary: A continuous C with an almost circular counter.
changes: One uninterrupted contour; no module seams.
Concentric-feeling curves and matched oblique terminal cuts.
The mark sits at 28px beside a restrained 20px Inter wordmark.

variants.label: Optical balance
variants.summary: A quieter upper bowl and a slightly fuller lower return.
changes: One uninterrupted contour; no hidden letters.
A slightly more upright bowl and a modestly extended lower terminal.
The same typography, scale and spacing as B1, so only the C changes.
